events.title: Tebo Train's Snowflake Express — limited free family train rides
events.time: 11:00 AM–2:00 PM MST (last departure 2:00 PM); also offered Sunday Dec 6 and Dec 13, 2026 at same time
events.location: 1200 block of Pearl Street; board in front of Wells Fargo, 1242 Pearl St, Boulder, CO
events.cost: No mandatory admission/ride charge; suggested $5 donation per group (five-person family can ride without a required fee; $5 suggested total)
events.age: Children 10 and under, accompanied by adults; public event; no residency restriction listed
events.description: Downtown Boulder Partnership official 2026 holiday event: rare three-Sunday opportunity for children to ride the 100% electric Tebo mini-train along downtown Pearl Street; accompanying adults allowed. Actual ride, not a talk or normal commercial class. Only November 29, December 6, December 13; all 11 AM–2 PM. No advance reservation specified; weather may cancel. Family of 2 adults+3 kids aged 7–10 fits stated age limit. Official source https://boulderdowntown.com/do/tebo-trains-snowflake-express. Approx 20 miles Westminster–Boulder city-to-city, not route-specific to 80234. This 2026 edition is for local residents, not the family arriving summer 2027.
